title: Split-term replacement for tower complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $I$ an integer-indexed cochain complex of inverse systems [def-weil-inverse-system]. There is a cochain complex $J$ of inverse systems and a quasi-isomorphism $u:I\to J$ such that every transition $J^p_{n+1}\to J^p_n$ is a split epimorphism, for every integer $p$ and natural number $n$. No boundedness, enough injectives, products or K-injectivity is assumed.

source.place: Tag 070M; agent-written split-envelope replacement of original Roos node, Step 5

proof.text:
Apply the additive split-envelope functor E and its natural monomorphism j
termwise. Let q be the cokernel chain map of j. The sequence 0 → I → E(I) → coker(j)
→ 0 is degreewise short exact, and both E(I) and coker(j) have split transitions.
The degreewise-epi kernel/cone comparison applied to q, followed by the canonical
isomorphism I ≅ ker(q), gives u : I → Cone(q)[-1], a quasi-isomorphism. Each term
of this shifted cone is a binary biproduct of two split towers. Biproducts of
sections are sections, so all transitions of this replacement split.

lean.statement:
theorem tower_split_complex_replacement
    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ) :
    ∃ (J : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ) (u : I ⟶ J),
      QuasiIso u ∧ ∀ (p : ℤ) (n : ℕ),
        IsSplitEpi ((J.X p).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)
